title: Theme Settings
shadcnStyleDesc: Pure black & white color scheme, clean modern UI style
defaultStyleDesc: Colorful theme, multiple color schemes available
iconColorDesc: Choose sidebar and button icon colors
bgSettingsDesc: Select preset background or upload custom image (only works in glassmorphism mode)
tip: Tip: Switch to glassmorphism mode to view background effects
autoSwitchGlass: Auto switched to glassmorphism mode to display background
cardOpacityDesc: Adjust card background opacity (applies to both solid and glassmorphism styles)
sidebarLayoutDesc: Choose floating card, docked glass panel, or divider-only
sidebarFloatingDesc: Sidebar appears as a rounded floating card with spacing from the main content
sidebarDockedDesc: Sidebar sits flush against the left edge with a glass/card surface
sidebarLineDesc: No card chrome or shadow—only a 1px vertical line separates the sidebar from content
sidebarDefaultStateDesc: Whether the sidebar starts expanded or collapsed to icons when you open the console
sidebarExpandedDesc: Sidebar opens fully with navigation labels visible
sidebarCollapsedDesc: Sidebar starts in icon-only mode; expand anytime
borderRadiusDesc: Globally control corner radius for cards, buttons, inputs, and more (circular badges are unchanged)
uiScaleDesc: Scale overall UI font size and rem-based spacing (85%–120%)
uiScalePreview: Preview: this text scales with the UI scale setting
presetsDesc: Save your theme combinations and switch anytime
savePresetDesc: Save all current theme settings as a named preset for quick switching
presetNameHint: Letters, digits, - _ . and spaces only, 1-64 characters
presetExists: This name already exists; saving will overwrite the existing preset
invalidHint: This preset file could not be parsed
deletePresetConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete preset "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
noPresetsHint: After tweaking your theme, click "Save as Preset" to store the current combination
